gc_counter_attestation.scope: installed Julia1.12.7 callback GC counter interpretation
observed: graph_node.jl callback start/end record Base.gc_num snapshots and Base.gc_total_bytes(stats).
Base/timing.jl computes gc_total_bytes as allocd + deferred_alloc + total_allocd.
Installed ijl_gc_num copies global GC counters and calls combine_thread_gc_counts; that helper walks jl_all_tls_states and adds current per-thread counters.
gc_counter_attestation.derived: Allocation bytes use live process-wide Julia GC allocation accounting, including current per-thread counters; they are not a total updated only at GC cycles.
limits: Snapshots collect different threads sequentially; they are not an atomic simultaneous process-wide snapshot.
GC-aware allocation accounting is not a record of all native/external malloc activity and does not isolate the callback thread.
Counters are read just inside callback timestamp endpoints; zero recorded deltas do not establish allocation freedom for excluded native entry/exit or every instant outside those reads.
